10 2.1  (T)(F)   BkltDev->I2cCfg != ((void *)0))

10 10   (T)            case REGMON_IDLE:
                    /* still counting down */
10 11    *               break;
10 12   (T)            case REGMON_PENDING:
                    /* Only proceed if no other register currently in use. */
10 13   (T)(F)           if (

                      {
10 18    *                     BacklightCdd_CurrentMonReg = RegIndex; /* claim the bus */
10 19    *                     BacklightCdd_RegRuntimeMonitor[RegIndex].state = REGMON_BUSY;

                    }
10 20    *               break;
10 21   (T)            case REGMON_BUSY:

                     {
10 26   (T)(F)               if ((
10 26.1 (T)(F)               (Reg_val & BkltDev->I2cCfg->monitorRegs[RegIndex].mask) !=
                       (BkltDev->I2cCfg->monitorRegs[RegIndex].CfgVal & BkltDev->I2cCfg->monitorRegs[RegIndex].mask)))
                      {
10 27    *                     switch (BkltDev->I2cCfg->monitorRegs[RegIndex].SafetyAction)
                       {
10 28   (T)                      case BACKLIGHT_INIT:
10 29    *                         BacklightDrvCdd_Init();
10 30    *                         (void)BacklightDrvCdd_RequestPower((0U), BACKLIGHTDRVCDD_POWER_STATE_POWER_ON);
10 31    *                         break;
10 32   (T)                      case BACKLIGHT_SAFESTATE:
                         /* TBD */
10 33    *                         break;
10 34   (T)                      default:
10 35    *                         break;
                       }
                      }
                     }
                     else
                     {
10 36    *                   BacklightCdd_RegRuntimeMonitor[RegIndex].firstReadDone = (boolean)(1U);
                     }
                     /* release bus, reload timer, go idle */
10 37    *                 BacklightCdd_CurrentMonReg = 0xFFu;
10 38    *                 BacklightCdd_RegRuntimeMonitor[RegIndex].timer = BkltDev->I2cCfg->monitorRegs[RegIndex].monitorTime;
10 39    *                 BacklightCdd_RegRuntimeMonitor[RegIndex].state = REGMON_IDLE;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                     /* else: result not ready yet — stay BUSY, poll next tick */
                    }
10 40    *               break;
10 41   (T)            default:
10 42    *               break;
                  }
                 }
                }
                else
                {
                 /*Invalid - Do Nothing */
                }
               }

               /** \brief MAX20446_CalcDutyRegisters
                **
                ** This function update register data for I2C.
                **
                ** \param[in] targetBrightness Target brightness value.
                **            txBuf            Buffer holding target brightness value after scaling
                **           
                ** \return    None.
                **
                ** */
               //======================================================================================================================
               void MAX20446_CalcDutyRegisters (uint16 targetBrightness , uint8* txBuf)
               {
                uint8 pwm1_0, pwm9_2, pwm17_10;
                uint32 duty;
2 0     (T)    MAX20446_CalcDutyRegisters
2 1      *       duty = (uint32) ((targetBrightness * (uint32)(0x10025))/100U);
2 2      *       pwm1_0 = (uint8)( duty & (uint32)0x03);
2 3      *       pwm9_2 = (uint8)( duty >> 2u) & 0xFFu;
2 4      *       pwm17_10 = (uint8)( duty >> 10u) & 0xFFu;
2 5      *       txBuf[0] = 0x04u; // starting register address
2 6      *       txBuf[1] = pwm17_10; // 0x04 - TONH1 - PWM1[17:10]
2 7      *       txBuf[2] = pwm9_2; // 0x05 - TONL1 - PWM1[9:2]
2 8      *       txBuf[3] = pwm17_10; // 0x06 - TONH2 - PWM2[17:10]
2 9      *       txBuf[4] = pwm9_2; // 0x07 - TONL2 - PWM2[9:2]
2 10     *       txBuf[5] = pwm17_10; // 0x08 - TONH3 - PWM3[17:10]
2 11     *       txBuf[6] = pwm9_2; // 0x09 - TONL3 - PWM3[9:2]
2 12     *       txBuf[7] = pwm17_10; // 0x0A - TONH4 - PWM4[17:10]
2 13     *       txBuf[8] = pwm9_2; // 0x0B - TONL4 - PWM4[9:2]
2 14     *       txBuf[9] = (pwm1_0 | (uint8) (pwm1_0 << 2u) | (uint8) (pwm1_0 << 4u) | (uint8) (pwm1_0 << 6u));
2 15     *       txBuf[10] = pwm17_10; // 0x0D - TONH5 - PWM5[17:10]
2 16     *       txBuf[11] = pwm9_2; // 0x0E - TONL5 - PWM5[9:2]
2 17     *       txBuf[12] = pwm17_10; // 0x0F - TONH6 - PWM6[17:10]
2 18     *       txBuf[13] = pwm9_2; // 0x10 - TONL6 - PWM6[9:2]
2 19     *       txBuf[14] = (pwm1_0 | (uint8) (pwm1_0 << 2u)); // 0x11 - TON5-6LSB - PWM6[1:0],PWM5[1:0]
               }
